# Summary

The statute's retention rule is: Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute.[[cite:obs-d3e5c5e7f634671a03764f3857fcd9fc059f9f8a "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]

The statute does not state a specific numeric duration; it refers to the period named in the schedule of the statute.[[cite:obs-d3e5c5e7f634671a03764f3857fcd9fc059f9f8a "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]
